description: X-Tech AntiStatic SLE is a three layer system comprising an epoxy primer, a water dispersed epoxy base coat and a self smoothing solvent free epoxy top coat that produces a conductive or dissipative floor.
notFor: May change color when exposed to direct sunlight.
Do not use solvent to finish the surface.
Do not apply at thicknesses greater than those mentioned.
Do not expose the surface to water or cleaning solutions until fully cured.

technicalData.label: Conductive grade (CG), point to point and to ground
Dissipative grade (DG), point to point and to ground
Bond strength, 7 days (depends on substrate quality)

consumption.quote: X-Prime SF: 10m2 (107ft2) per liter at 100 microns wft.
X-Prime MT100: 5m2 (53ft2) per liter at 200 microns wft.
X-Tech AntiStatic SLE Base Coat: 6.6m2 (70ft2) per liter at 150 microns wft.
X-Tech AntiStatic SLE Top Coat: 1.5L per m2 at 1.5mm (60mils).

packaging: X-Tech AntiStatic SLE Base Coat: 4.5 and 18L packs
storage: 18 months when stored at 35C (95F) or less in a frost-free, dry and shaded area.
advantages: Meets SCAQMD Rule 1113 & LEED VOC Limits
